svg.title: Kernel support vector classifier
svg.desc: The decision function of a kernel support vector classifier is the bias -0.0748 plus a weighted sum of the Gaussian kernel, gamma 0.25 similarity to each support vector: the training rows on or inside the margin. Each is drawn on the standardised scale and coloured by the class it pulls towards; hover for its coefficient. The axes are the two principal components of the stored rows: the first is led by account_age +0.67, merchant_risk -0.58, amount +0.37; the second is led by velocity +0.6, amount +0.57, merchant_risk +0.56.
